fusions.name: Muttered Clause
fusions.desc: Sends a strand that deals 5 damage. The target is [Muddled], slowing its casting for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Cited Authority
fusions.desc: A blow that deals 32 damage and leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds. You and every ally within 5 tiles deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Strike from the Record
fusions.desc: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Margin Note
fusions.desc: When you put a condition on an enemy, you regain 8 mana. Once every 8 seconds.
